t: This is the former Whitefield's Tabernacle, at the corner of Tabernacle Street and Leonard Street in Moorfields. The first church here was a wooden building put up in 1741 by followers of the evangelical preacher George Whitefield. A brick building replaced it in 1753. After Whitefield died in 1770, John Wesley preached a sermon on his death here. John Broadwood, the Scottish founder of the piano makers Broadwood and Sons, is buried here.
